changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE locations ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description TEXT, category VARCHAR(100), latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, geom GEOMETRY(Point, 4326), nearest_road_name VARCHAR(255), nearest_road_highway VARCHAR(100), nearest_road_distance DOUBLE PRECISION, is_default BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW() );

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO locations (name, category, latitude, longitude, geom, is_default) SELECT p.name, p.amenity AS category, ST_Y(ST_Transform(p.way, 4326)) AS latitude, ST_X(ST_Transform(p.way, 4326)) AS longitude, ST_Transform(p.way, 4326) AS geom, true FROM planet_osm_point p WHERE p.amenity IN ( 'school', 'hospital', 'pharmacy', 'supermarket', 'restaurant', 'cafe', 'bank', 'fuel', 'park', 'library', 'post_office', 'police', 'fire_station' ) AND p.name IS NOT NULL;
